Hyper120 unlocks the screen, but each game has its own limit. Games tagged 60 MAX stop at 60 FPS whatever you do. Turn on the high frame-rate option inside the game too. Long-press a game for tips, its own rate, or to report how it runs.
Tip: in App info, turn on Autostart and set Battery saver to No restrictions so HyperOS keeps Hyper120 running.

HyperOS caps many games at 60Hz. Hyper120 removes that cap only for the games you choose. Everything else keeps adaptive refresh, so battery life stays the same. No root, no PC.
Every game has its own limit

Hyper120 unlocks the screen, but a game still decides how many frames it draws. Some never go above 60. Others only offer 120 in their own settings, often only on phones the developer has approved. Look for these tags in the app list:
Can go above 60. Turn it on in the game\'s graphics settings.
The game stops at 60. Nothing can make it faster.
